{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/trial.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter out sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
# We treat -999.0 as missing and exclude those rows
filtered_data = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Check the new sample size
print("Filtered data size:", len(filtered_data))

# Check the distribution of arm in filtered data
print("\nArm distribution after filtering:", filtered_data['arm'].value_counts())

# Check the response rate by arm in filtered data
response_rates = filtered_data.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
print("\nResponse rates by arm:\n", response_rates)

# Compute the treatment effect as difference in proportions (treatment - control)
treatment_effect = response_rates['treatment'] - response_rates['control']
print("\nTreatment effect (treatment - control):", treatment_effect)"}
